tasks.label: safari probe
tasks.command: SIM=8604942C-0C93-4F81-8E27-C0E5C7E9CAA7; xcrun simctl launch $SIM com.apple.mobilesafari > /dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; ( xcrun simctl openurl $SIM 'https://example.com/' & sleep 25; kill %1 2>/dev/null ) ; sleep 8; xcrun simctl io $SIM screenshot /Volumes/Storage/tmp/safari-3.png && sips -Z 1100 -s format jpeg /Volumes/Storage/tmp/safari-3.png --out /Volumes/Storage/tmp/safari-3.jpg > /dev/null && echo PROBE_DONE

tasks.label: shot now
tasks.command: SIM=8604942C-0C93-4F81-8E27-C0E5C7E9CAA7; ls -la /Volumes/Storage/tmp/safari-3.jpg 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl io $SIM screenshot /Volumes/Storage/tmp/now.png >/dev/null 2>&1; sips -Z 1100 -s format jpeg /Volumes/Storage/tmp/now.png --out /Volumes/Storage/tmp/now.jpg >/dev/null && echo SHOT_OK
